title: Standalone pipelines on serverless general compute are now generally available
body: Creating and refreshing standalone materialized views and streaming tables from a notebook on serverless general compute is now generally available. You can define them with SQL through `spark.sql()` or with the Python pipelines decorators. See [Notebooks](/aws/en/sql/mv-st/compute#notebooks) and [Use Python with standalone pipelines](/aws/en/sql/mv-st/using-python).
